s0001.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, Dadu Route chief prefecture was changed to the Metropolitan chief prefecture.
s0001.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month of spring, on wushen day, Dadu Route chief prefecture was changed to the Metropolitan chief prefecture.

s0002.literal: On gengxu day Venus encroached upon Ox.
s0002.idiomatic: On gengxu day Venus encroached upon Ox.

s0003.literal: The Reserve Stores supervisory office was changed to the Military Stores Bureau, at rank 3b.
s0003.idiomatic: The Reserve Stores supervisory office was changed to the Military Stores Bureau, at rank 3b.

s0004.literal: Arigh Fire, pacification commissioner of Hedong-Shanxi Circuit, was made right vice chancellor of the Ministry Secretariat; his pacification commissionership remained as before.
s0004.idiomatic: Arigh Fire, pacification commissioner of Hedong-Shanxi Circuit, was made right vice chancellor of the ministry secretariat; his pacification commissionership remained as before.

s0005.literal: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0005.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0006.literal: An edict ordered the sons and younger brothers of attendant officials to enter the Directorate of Education.
s0006.idiomatic: An edict ordered the sons and younger brothers of attendant officials to enter the Directorate of Education.

s0007.literal: King Chen Rixuan of Annam dispatched his middle grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.
s0007.idiomatic: King Chen Rixuan of Annam sent his middle grandee Chen Keyong to present local products as tribute.

s0008.literal: On yimao day a tent hall for sacrificing to Heaven was constructed.
s0008.idiomatic: On yimao day a tent hall for sacrificing to Heaven was constructed.

s0009.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched envoys to present local products as tribute.
s0009.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent envoys to present local products as tribute.

s0010.literal: On dingsi day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Sea God, and Earth Altar on the Emperor's behalf.
s0010.idiomatic: On dingsi day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Sea God, and Earth Altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0011.literal: On wuwu day, since Nayan's rebellion, Liaoyang's people were greatly exhausted; five thousand eighty ingots of notes were issued to relieve them.
s0011.idiomatic: On wuwu day, since Nayan's rebellion, Liaoyang's people were greatly exhausted; 5,080 ingots of notes were issued to relieve them.

s0012.literal: On jiwei day Prince Yahudu of Zhenyuan and Prince Hede of Jingyuan were each granted one gilt silver seal.
s0012.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince Yahudu of Zhenyuan and Prince Hede of Jingyuan were each granted one gilt silver seal.

s0013.literal: Zhangji raided Ganmuli; Princes Shibo, Bayanhan, and Yilinzhen drove him off.
s0013.idiomatic: Zhangji raided Ganmuli; Princes Shibo, Bayanhan, and Yilinzhen drove him off.

s0014.literal: On gengshen day relay-station households for horses suffering famine were relieved.
s0014.idiomatic: On gengshen day relay-station households for horses suffering famine were relieved.

s0015.literal: Cattle and seed were granted to three thousand households of the Tengjie'er Muslim garrison-farm colony.
s0015.idiomatic: Cattle and seed were granted to 3,000 households of the Tengjie'er Muslim garrison-farm colony.

s0016.literal: On xinyou day construction of the Yizhou granary was undertaken.
s0016.idiomatic: On xinyou day construction of the Yizhou granary was undertaken.

s0017.literal: On renxu day long armor was made and issued to the northern campaign army.
s0017.idiomatic: On renxu day long armor was made and issued to the northern campaign army.

s0018.literal: On yichou day Shensi, Barshidar, Yelü Sishi, and Shimo Mantai—four men—were executed for plotting rebellion.
s0018.idiomatic: On yichou day Shensi, Barshidar, Yelü Sishi, and Shimo Mantai—four men—were executed for plotting rebellion.

s0019.literal: On bingyin day, because Hedan's remaining bandits were not yet pacified, Goryeo was ordered to dispatch one thousand Tamna garrison troops to suppress them.
s0019.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because Hedan's remaining bandits were not yet pacified, Goryeo was ordered to dispatch 1,000 Tamna garrison troops to suppress them.

s0020.literal: Horses were granted to the five hundred men of the Hexi hostage army.
s0020.idiomatic: Horses were granted to the 500 men of the Hexi hostage army.

s0021.literal: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Fang.
s0021.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Fang.

s0022.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo said: "Your subject once served as palace guard in the capital; when Lin Yan rebelled, the country fell into great disorder, and Goryeo residents in Datong were all registered; your subject wishes to have them again returned to Goryeo as commoners.
s0022.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo said, "Your subject once served as palace guard in the capital; when Lin Yan rebelled, the country fell into great disorder, and Goryeo residents in Datong were all registered; your subject wishes to have them returned to Goryeo as commoners.

s0024.literal: On jisi day the Southwestern Tribal chief prefecture was changed to Yongning Circuit.
s0024.idiomatic: On jisi day the Southwestern Tribal chief prefecture was changed to Yongning Circuit.

s0025.literal: On xinwei day ten thousand ingots of notes were granted to the ten thousand men under Yesüderi's command.
s0025.idiomatic: On xinwei day 10,000 ingots of notes were granted to the 10,000 men under Yesüderi's command.

s0026.literal: Fengyun garrison-farming households suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0026.idiomatic: Fengyun garrison-farming households suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0027.literal: Wuwei Circuit suffered great flood; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0027.idiomatic: Wuwei Circuit suffered great flood; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0028.literal: On guiyou day the Biejiare garrison-farming households under Xindu suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0028.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Biejiare garrison-farming households under Xindu suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0029.literal: Linhuai Prefecture was reduced to Xuyi County and placed under Si Prefecture.
s0029.idiomatic: Linhuai Prefecture was reduced to Xuyi County and placed under Si Prefecture.

s0030.literal: The Xingwen Office was re-established, in charge of scripture printing blocks and Jiangnan school-land revenues and grain.
s0030.idiomatic: The Xingwen Office was re-established, in charge of scripture printing blocks and Jiangnan school-land revenues and grain.

s0032.literal: Second month, on the yihai new moon, the Ten-thousand-household Office of Jeolla Province was established.
s0032.idiomatic: Second month, on the yihai new moon, the ten-thousand-household office of Jeolla Province was established.

s0033.literal: Bandits in the various prefectures of Jiangxi were not yet pacified; an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to assign one thousand troops as reinforcement.
s0033.idiomatic: Bandits in the various prefectures of Jiangxi were not yet pacified; an edict ordered the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat to assign 1,000 troops as reinforcement.

s0034.literal: The Imperial Stud was ordered not to be subordinate to the Xuanzheng Court.
s0034.idiomatic: The Imperial Stud was ordered not to be subordinate to the Xuanzheng Court.

s0035.literal: On bingzi day newly submitted garrison-farming households suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0035.idiomatic: On bingzi day newly submitted garrison-farming households suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0036.literal: Four hundred ninety-one monks and Daoist priests of Shun Prefecture suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0036.idiomatic: 491 monks and Daoist priests of Shun Prefecture suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0037.literal: On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Net.
s0037.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Net.

s0038.literal: Ningyuan and other counties of Kaiyuan Circuit suffered famine; commoners and relay-station households fled; two thousand ingots of notes were issued to relieve them.
s0038.idiomatic: Ningyuan and other counties of Kaiyuan Circuit suffered famine; commoners and relay-station households fled; 2,000 ingots of notes were issued to relieve them.

s0039.literal: Bo Prefecture pacification commissioner Yang Hanying presented one thousand rain felts; imperial son-in-law Tiebiechi presented sixty Rus rain felts, fifty knives, and twenty bows.
s0039.idiomatic: Bo Prefecture pacification commissioner Yang Hanying presented 1,000 rain felts; imperial son-in-law Tiebiechi presented 60 Rus rain felts, 50 knives, and 20 bows.

s0040.literal: On jimao day Xing'an in Xing Prefecture suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0040.idiomatic: On jimao day Xing'an in Xing Prefecture suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0041.literal: On gengchen day commoner households of Badakhan suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0041.idiomatic: On gengchen day commoner households of Badakhan suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0042.literal: On xinsi day household registration of the former shibich in Hejian was conducted.
s0042.idiomatic: On xinsi day household registration of the former shibich in Hejian was conducted.

s0043.literal: On guawei day Quanzhou suffered earthquake.
s0043.idiomatic: On guawei day Quanzhou suffered earthquake.

s0044.literal: On yiyou day newly submitted residents living in Changping were relieved.
s0044.idiomatic: On yiyou day newly submitted residents living in Changping were relieved.

s0045.literal: On bingxu day Fengxian County was changed to Fangshan County.
s0045.idiomatic: On bingxu day Fengxian County was changed to Fangshan County.

s0047.literal: On jichou day the Jiangxi bandits Zhong Mingliang and others again surrendered; an edict ordered the ringleaders relocated to the capital while the remaining followers were granted grain.
s0047.idiomatic: On jichou day the Jiangxi bandits Zhong Mingliang and others again surrendered; an edict ordered the ringleaders relocated to the capital while the remaining followers were granted grain.

s0048.literal: The various prefectures of Zhedong suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0048.idiomatic: The various prefectures of Zhedong suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0049.literal: On gengyin day the moon encroached upon Neck.
s0049.idiomatic: On gengyin day the moon encroached upon Neck.

s0050.literal: On xinmao day the Nankang and Xingguo tea monopoly supervisory office was re-established, at rank 5b.
s0050.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Nankang and Xingguo tea monopoly supervisory office was re-established at rank 5b.

s0051.literal: Two thousand tiger guards and rotated-off-duty soldiers were dispatched to Shangdu to repair the city walls.
s0051.idiomatic: 2,000 tiger guards and rotated-off-duty soldiers were dispatched to Shangdu to repair the city walls.

s0052.literal: Renqiu in Hejian Circuit suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0052.idiomatic: Renqiu in Hejian Circuit suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0053.literal: On guisi day Jiling and Wuxi two counties suffered crop damage from continuous rain; their field rents were remitted.
s0053.idiomatic: On guisi day Jiling and Wuxi two counties suffered crop damage from continuous rain; their field rents were remitted.

s0054.literal: Jiangxi bandits Hua Dalao, Huang Dalao, and others plundered Lechang and other prefectures; the mobile privy council suppressed them.
s0054.idiomatic: Jiangxi bandits Hua Dalao, Huang Dalao, and others plundered Lechang and other prefectures; the mobile privy council suppressed them.

s0055.literal: Unregistered households under Chawu suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0055.idiomatic: Unregistered households under Chawu suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0056.literal: Changning Prefecture commoners had suffered bandit disorder; their field rent was remitted.
s0056.idiomatic: Changning Prefecture commoners had suffered bandit disorder; their field rent was remitted.

s0057.literal: On jihai day Dingxing in Baoding Circuit suffered famine; five thousand two hundred sixty-four shi of grain was issued to relieve them.
s0057.idiomatic: On jihai day Dingxing in Baoding Circuit suffered famine; 5,264 shi of grain was issued to relieve them.

s0058.literal: On xinchou day Suohuan's crops failed; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0058.idiomatic: On xinchou day Suohuan's crops failed; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0059.literal: Third month, on yisi day, Zhongshan hunting households suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0059.idiomatic: Third month, on yisi day, Zhongshan hunting households suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0060.literal: On wushen day the Guangji Office suffered famine; two thousand two hundred fifty shi of grain was granted as seed.
s0060.idiomatic: On wushen day the Guangji Office suffered famine; 2,250 shi of grain was granted as seed.

s0061.literal: On renzi day Mars encroached upon Hooked Clasp.
s0061.idiomatic: On renzi day Mars encroached upon Hooked Clasp.

s0062.literal: Rice-farming households of Yuyang and other places in Ji Prefecture suffered famine; thirty days' grain was granted.
s0062.idiomatic: Rice-farming households of Yuyang and other places in Ji Prefecture suffered famine; 30 days' grain was granted.

s0063.literal: On wuwu day grain from the Mang'an granary was issued to relieve four hundred twenty persons under Yanbasar.
s0063.idiomatic: On wuwu day grain from the Mang'an granary was issued to relieve 420 persons under Yanbasar.

s0064.literal: On jiwei day Yunnan's Menglian district was changed to the Menglian Circuit civil-military chief prefecture, and Menglai district to Menglai Circuit.
s0064.idiomatic: On jiwei day Yunnan's Menglian district was changed to the Menglian Circuit civil-military chief prefecture, and Menglai district to Menglai Circuit.

s0065.literal: Fujian hunting households and sharkskin households were dismissed and released as commoners; the matter was transferred to regular officials for overall management.
s0065.idiomatic: Fujian hunting households and sharkskin households were dismissed and released as commoners; the matter was transferred to regular officials for overall management.

s0066.literal: Civilian laborers of Yun Prefecture were dispatched to excavate silver mines.
s0066.idiomatic: Civilian laborers of Yun Prefecture were dispatched to excavate silver mines.

s0067.literal: Yongchang relay-station households suffered famine; many sold their children and slaves; Gansu Province was ordered to redeem them and issue rice for relief.
s0067.idiomatic: Yongchang relay-station households suffered famine; many sold their children and slaves; Gansu Province was ordered to redeem them and issue rice for relief.

s0068.literal: The artisan supervisory offices of Fu and Quan two prefectures were merged into one, and those without corvée duties were again released as commoners.
s0068.idiomatic: The artisan supervisory offices of Fu and Quan two prefectures were merged into one, and those without corvée duties were again released as commoners.

s0069.literal: On gengshen day the censorate's attendant censor was promoted to rank 4a and the investigating censor to rank 5a; one additional Mongol bureau director was added at rank 5b.
s0069.idiomatic: On gengshen day the censorate's attendant censor was promoted to rank 4a and the investigating censor to rank 5a; one additional Mongol bureau director was added at rank 5b.

s0070.literal: The mobile Directorate of Agriculture and the agricultural promotion and garrison-farming offices of each circuit were abolished;
s0070.idiomatic: The mobile Directorate of Agriculture and the agricultural promotion and garrison-farming offices of each circuit were abolished;

s0071.literal: two additional deputy commissioners of the surveillance commission for punishment and investigation were added to oversee agricultural promotion affairs.
s0071.idiomatic: two additional deputy commissioners of the surveillance commission for punishment and investigation were added to oversee agricultural promotion affairs.

s0072.literal: The Sichuan branch secretariat had formerly moved to Chongqing; Chengdu's people suffered from supplying it; an edict ordered it moved back to administer from Chengdu.
s0072.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch secretariat had formerly moved to Chongqing; Chengdu's people suffered from supplying it; an edict ordered it moved back to administer from Chengdu.

s0073.literal: The Jiangnan garrison-farming supervisory office was established at rank 5b, in charge of Buddhist monasteries' property.
s0073.idiomatic: The Jiangnan garrison-farming supervisory office was established at rank 5b, in charge of Buddhist monasteries' property.

s0074.literal: One thousand nine hundred fifty-nine households of Shou and Ying garrison-farming troops were released as commoners, and Jiangnan garrison troops were withdrawn to replace them.
s0074.idiomatic: 1,959 households of Shou and Ying garrison-farming troops were released as commoners, and Jiangnan garrison troops were withdrawn to replace them.

s0075.literal: All artisans under Lü Hela, Anige, and Duan Zhen who had no corvée duties were differentiated and released as commoners.
s0075.idiomatic: All artisans under Lü Hela, Anige, and Duan Zhen who had no corvée duties were differentiated and released as commoners.

s0076.literal: An edict ordered that selection for censorial posts should again return to the censorate, as in the former system.
s0076.idiomatic: An edict ordered that selection for censorial posts should again return to the censorate, as in the former system.

s0077.literal: Native chiefs were established for forty-two stockades including Dayi in Jinzhu Prefecture.
s0077.idiomatic: Native chiefs were established for 42 stockades including Dayi in Jinzhu Prefecture.

s0078.literal: On guihai day the Jianchang bandits Qiu Yuan and others styled themselves dalao, gathered more than one thousand followers, and plundered Nanfeng and other prefectures; the Jianchang deputy ten-thousand-household captured and executed them.
s0078.idiomatic: On guihai day the Jianchang bandits Qiu Yuan and others styled themselves dalao, gathered more than 1,000 followers, and plundered Nanfeng and other prefectures; the Jianchang deputy ten-thousand-household captured and executed them.

s0079.literal: On jiazi day Yang Zhenlong's remaining followers plundered Zhedong; officials suppressing bandits frequently captured and plundered common people; an edict ordered the mobile censorate to sort them out; in all one thousand six hundred ninety-five who were commoners were identified.
s0079.idiomatic: On jiazi day Yang Zhenlong's remaining followers plundered Zhedong; officials suppressing bandits frequently captured and plundered common people; an edict ordered the mobile censorate to sort them out; in all 1,695 who were commoners were identified.

s0080.literal: On gengwu day, because Guangchang County of Jianchang Circuit had suffered Zhong Mingliang's disorder, nine thousand four hundred forty-seven shi of its field rent was remitted.
s0080.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because Guangchang County of Jianchang Circuit had suffered Zhong Mingliang's disorder, 9,447 shi of its field rent was remitted.

s0081.literal: On xinwei day the bandit Ye Dawu of Taiping County gathered more than one hundred followers and raided Ningguo; all were captured and executed.
s0081.idiomatic: On xinwei day the bandit Ye Dawu of Taiping County gathered more than 100 followers and raided Ningguo; all were captured and executed.

s0082.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the guiyou new moon, the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0082.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on the guiyou new moon, the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0083.literal: Wuzhou suffered locust damage to crops; great thunder and rain fell, and the locusts all died.
s0083.idiomatic: Wuzhou suffered locust damage to crops; great thunder and rain fell, and the locusts all died.

s0084.literal: On bingzi day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0084.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0085.literal: On xinsi day Dadu Route was ordered to use sixty-two thousand five hundred sixty-four shi of grain to relieve displaced persons at Tongzhou, Hexiwu, and other places.
s0085.idiomatic: On xinsi day Dadu Route was ordered to use 62,564 shi of grain to relieve displaced persons at Tongzhou, Hexiwu, and other places.

s0086.literal: The Shaobo garrison-farm colony, because continuous rain caused the river to overflow, had more than twenty-two thousand four hundred eighty mu of crops damaged; its rent was remitted.
s0086.idiomatic: The Shaobo garrison-farm colony, because continuous rain caused the river to overflow, had more than 22,480 mu of crops damaged; its rent was remitted.

s0087.literal: On guawei day the sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household office was abolished.
s0087.idiomatic: On guawei day the sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household office was abolished.

s0088.literal: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said: "Recently the court dispatched Bai Jiejue, who consulted with Shabuding to order issuing consolidated households together with Song clansmen to the capital; popular sentiment would surely be shaken; the people of Jiangnan are just now suffering from increased levies, household registration, and horse requisition—this should await another day.
s0088.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai branch secretariat said, "Recently the court dispatched Bai Jiejue, who consulted with Shabuding to order issuing consolidated households together with Song clansmen to the capital; popular sentiment would surely be shaken; the people of Jiangnan are just now suffering from increased levies, household registration, and horse requisition—this should await another day.

s0090.literal: Two hundred ninety-five persons including Asudun lacked food; they were ordered verified and granted grain for relief.
s0090.idiomatic: 295 persons including Asudun lacked food; they were ordered verified and granted grain for relief.

s0091.literal: The Lijin sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household office was changed to the Linqing Imperial Canal grain transport chief ten-thousand-household office.
s0091.idiomatic: The Lijin sea-route grain transport ten-thousand-household office was changed to the Linqing Imperial Canal grain transport chief ten-thousand-household office.

s0092.literal: The appanage households of Prince Xiaoxie, twelve thousand sixty-one in all, suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0092.idiomatic: The appanage households of Prince Xiaoxie, 12,061 in all, suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0093.literal: Ten thousand Han troops of the six guards were dispatched to cut timber for city-wall repair materials.
s0093.idiomatic: 10,000 Han troops of the six guards were dispatched to cut timber for city-wall repair materials.

s0094.literal: On jiashen day, because of repeated famine, this year's silver-salary notes were remitted; for those at Shangdu, Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, and Pingluan, ten thousand one hundred eighty ingots; for those in Liaoyang Province, one thousand three hundred forty-eight odd ingots.
s0094.idiomatic: On jiashen day, because of repeated famine, this year's silver-salary notes were remitted; for those at Shangdu, Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, and Pingluan, 10,180 ingots; for those in Liaoyang Province, 1,348 odd ingots.

s0095.literal: On bingxu day Sangjilashi and others were dispatched to the kingdom of Ma'bar to seek out skilled practitioners.
s0095.idiomatic: On bingxu day Sangjilashi and others were dispatched to the kingdom of Ma'bar to seek out skilled practitioners.

s0096.literal: On renchen day Mars remained in Root for more than ten days.
s0096.idiomatic: On renchen day Mars remained in Root for more than 10 days.

s0097.literal: On guisi day seventeen prefectures of Hebei suffered locust plague.
s0097.idiomatic: On guisi day 17 prefectures of Hebei suffered locust plague.

s0098.literal: Commoners under chiliarchs Yesen and Xiao Kökö and commoner households of Xilu, Bubie, and others all suffered famine; Hedong circuits were ordered to relieve them according to measure.
s0098.idiomatic: Commoners under chiliarchs Yesen and Xiao Kökö and commoner households of Xilu, Bubie, and others all suffered famine; Hedong circuits were ordered to relieve them according to measure.

s0099.literal: Those under chiliarch Yebugan lacked food; grain was ordered issued for relief.
s0099.idiomatic: Those under chiliarch Yebugan lacked food; grain was ordered issued for relief.

s0100.literal: Grand Preceptor Yulülu said: "Gathering the Ikires under Wozhe, six hundred twenty-one have now been obtained; they are ordered to garrison-farm together with Goryeo commoners; provisions should be granted them.
s0100.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Yulülu said, "Gathering the Ikires under Wozhe, 621 have now been obtained; they are ordered to garrison-farm together with Goryeo commoners; provisions should be granted them.
